name: The Gray Rot
description: The scripted general (SPEC §7.9): no analysis, no counters, no intel. Since M2 it merges, switching merging off on its swarm buildings while the player fields over 25% Slayers (§7.2). In runs (M3) its kit grows by battle index (§7.8): the opener plus one preferred blueprint per battle; single battles keep the whole roster.
